slides.headline: Build a personal brand in 5 steps
slides.sub: No fluff. No followers needed. Just a system that compounds.

slides.headline: Pick one platform & go deep
slides.body: Master one channel before you spread thin. Authority is built through sustained presence, not omnipresence.

slides.headline: Document what you build
slides.body: Share what you're already doing in real time. Your daily process is someone else's breakthrough.

slides.headline: The compounding levers
items: Direct audience relationship via private channels

slides.body: of consistent posting before most creators see compounding inbound opportunities.

slides.quote: Your brand is what people say about you when you're not in the room.

slides.headline: Start building today
slides.body: Revisit this playbook every quarter to keep your brand aligned with your ambitions.
